newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QNI suspended before Gencor deal news.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QNI suspended before Gencor deal news.

text.p: Trade in shares in nickel producer QNI Ltd were suspended on Wednesday at the company's request pending the announcement of the details of QNI's merger deal with the nickel arm of South African resources group Gencor Ltd.
The suspension would remain in place until the close of business on Friday or on receipt of an announcement from the company, the Australian Stock Exchange said.
QNI and Gencor announced on June 20 the initial details of a planned merger with Gencor's nickel business valuing the combined group at A$2.3 billion.
Under the merger, Gencor gets a 56 percent stake in QNI through the issue of 524.8 million new shares in QNI.
Gencor is expected to release on Friday an independent report on the merger plan including further details of the merger.
Investors reacted badly to the merger plan, arguing that the assets contributed by Gencor to the merger, including the Cerro Matoso nickel in Colombia.
QNI shares closed up 11 cents at A$2.50 on Tuesday.
